mentions.name: Dexbindr
mentions.description: An app for trading card collectors that helps with card pricing, scanning, and tracking to complete a Pokedex binder collection.
mentions.problem: Carrying an 11-pound card binder to card shows is cumbersome, and collectors need help with pricing, scanning, and tracking cards to finish their collections.
mentions.audience: Trading card collectors, particularly those working on completing card binder collections and attending card shows
mentions.source_excerpt: My co founder and i (aka Opus 5.5 and me) have been building https://www.dexbindr.com/ for the past few months now. It started with wanting to complete a pokedex binder but i hated carrying my 11 pounder card binder to card shows. Decided to build this app to help with card pricing, scanning and tracking to get my binder to completion.
mentions.author: arjunnvl
